disagreements.sql: SELECT receipt_no, transaction_no FROM (SELECT pos_sale.receipt_no AS receipt_no, pos_sale.transaction_no AS transaction_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pos_sale.receipt_no ORDER BY pos_sale.sale_date DESC NULLS LAST, pos_sale.transaction_no DESC NULLS LAST) AS latest_rank FROM public.pos_sale) AS latest WHERE latest_rank = 1 ORDER BY receipt_no NULLS FIRST

SELECT pos_sale.receipt_no AS receipt_no, pos_sale.origin_transaction_no AS origin_transaction_no, SUM(pos_saleitem.amount) FILTER(WHERE pos_sale.total_amount <> %(f_0)s) AS m0 FROM public.pos_saleitem LEFT JOIN public.pos_sale ON pos_saleitem.transaction_no = pos_sale.transaction_no WHERE pos_sale.origin_transaction_no IS NULL AND (pos_sale.sale_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' >= DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', (SELECT MAX(pos_sale.sale_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') FROM public.pos_saleitem LEFT JOIN public.pos_sale ON pos_saleitem.transaction_no = pos_sale.transaction_no WHERE pos_sale.origin_transaction_no IS NULL)) AND pos_sale.sale_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' < (DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', (SELECT MAX(pos_sale.sale_date AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei') FROM public.pos_saleitem LEFT JOIN public.pos_sale ON pos_saleitem.transaction_no = pos_sale.transaction_no WHERE pos_sale.origin_transaction_no IS NULL)) + INTERVAL '1 week')) GROUP BY pos_sale.receipt_no, pos_sale.origin_transaction_no ORDER BY receipt_no NULLS FIRST, origin_transaction_no NULLS FIRST
